title: AI clients (MCP)
lead: Claude, Cursor and other AI clients work in the Studio with its tools on your behalf over the Model Context Protocol.
serverOff: The MCP server is turned off on this installation. An administrator turns it on.

enable.label: Enable the MCP server
enable.hint: Clients connect at the address below. A disabled server answers 503.

files.title: Documents and files
files.hint: Read, search, edit, write, move and delete files.

build.title: Build
build.hint: Run a build, history, log, cancel.

history.title: History and git
history.hint: Versions, snapshots, rewind, git remote exchange.

admin.title: Administration
admin.hint: Users, queue, runners, audit, mail log. Only for an instance administrator with an MCP: administration token.

tools.lead: A client does not see a disabled tool. Dangerous ones (delete, rewind, git sync) are enabled by name.
tools.tokenHint: To connect, issue a token with the MCP permission: Settings → Account → Tokens.

connect.title: Connecting
connect.hintLocal: No token needed: the server only answers programs on this computer.
connect.hintServer: You need a token with the MCP permission. Put it in place of hsd_pat_... or set the HSE_STUDIO_TOKEN environment variable if the config refers to it.
connect.tokenEnv: The token comes from the {{env}} environment variable: set it before starting the client.

clients.stdio: Claude Desktop, JetBrains AI Assistant and others (stdio)

where.claudeCode: Run it in a terminal. Check: claude mcp list.
where.codex: Run it in a terminal. The entry lands in ~/.codex/config.toml, which the CLI, the IDE extension and the app all read. Check: codex mcp list.
where.opencode: Add it to the project's opencode.json or to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json.
where.gemini: Add it to ~/.gemini/settings.json or to the project's .gemini/settings.json.
where.cursor: Add it to ~/.cursor/mcp.json or to the project's .cursor/mcp.json.
where.vscode: Add it to ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json or to .mcp.json at the project root.
where.cline: Cline: the Configure tab, the Configure MCP Servers button.
where.junie: Add it to ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json or to the project's .junie/mcp/mcp.json.
where.stdio: The hse-doc-studio mcp bridge forwards requests to the Studio. In JetBrains AI Assistant: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP).

journal.title: Call log
journal.hint: Recent calls: tool, who, outcome and time. Arguments are not stored.

failure.unknown: The request failed. Try again later.
